Sandbox_VehicleBallistics2D_Enabled_tool: Shots hit the real part of a vehicle (glass, tyres, lights, doors, hood, engine, tank, armour) instead of a random part of that side.
Sandbox_VehicleBallistics2D_In2D: Vehicle hits: also in the normal 2D view
Sandbox_VehicleBallistics2D_In2D_tooltip: Also for shots without True Ballistics (vanilla firing, isometric view). The shot then flies straight along your aim at muzzle height.
Sandbox_VehicleBallistics2D_HitInfo: Vehicle hits: tell the shooter what was hit
Sandbox_VehicleBallistics2D_HitInfo_tool: A short text over your character, e.g. "Tyre rear left: flat". Each player can switch it off in the mod options.
Sandbox_VehicleBallistics2D_DamageScale_: Multiplies all part damage from bullets.
Sandbox_VehicleBallistics2D_WindshieldSh: Windshield: hits until it caves in
Laminated glass keeps its holes and stays in place. Hits from a 9 mm until it falls in; stronger rounds count more (rifle about 2x), weaker less.
Sandbox_VehicleBallistics2D_SideWindowSh: Side and rear windows: shatter chance per hit (%)
Tempered glass usually bursts completely at the first hit. Otherwise a hole with cracks.
Sandbox_VehicleBallistics2D_TireShotsStr: Tyres: hits until flat (rifles, slugs, magnums)
Sandbox_VehicleBallistics2D_TireShotsWea: Tyres: hits until flat (.22, .38, single shotgun pellets)
Every pellet of a shotgun counts on its own, so a close shotgun blast usually flattens a tyre.
Sandbox_VehicleBallistics2D_TireMode_too: Flat at once: after the hits above the tyre is flat. Slow leak: every hole leaks, more holes faster; flat after the time below.
Sandbox_VehicleBallistics2D_RunFlat_tool: Vehicles with a run-flat or tyre inflation system (KI5) or wheel armour only lose some condition.
Sandbox_VehicleBallistics2D_BodyDamage_t: Doors, hood, trunk, bumpers - for a 9 mm, stronger rounds more.
Sandbox_VehicleBallistics2D_EngineDamage: Engine and radiator: damage per hit (%)
Sandbox_VehicleBallistics2D_Occupants: Shots through glass and doors can hit people inside
Sandbox_VehicleBallistics2D_Occupants_to: Depends on the energy left: rifles go through doors, small calibres often stay in the sheet metal.
Sandbox_VehicleBallistics2D_ArmorWear_to: Armour plates and armoured glass (KI5 and other mods) stop most rounds with a scrape and wear down slowly.
Sandbox_VehicleBallistics2D_DriveBy_tool: In a vehicle with a firearm in hand: hold the right mouse button to aim, left click to shoot (full auto keeps firing). A closed window you shoot through gets a hole or shatters; open (rolled down) windows stay intact. Needs Viewpoint True Ballistics.
Sandbox_VehicleBallistics2D_DriverCanSho: Shooting from vehicles: the driver may shoot
Sandbox_VehicleBallistics2D_DriveBySprea: Multiplies the normal spread (skill, moodles, movement).
Sandbox_VehicleBallistics2D_DriverSpread: Shooting from vehicles: extra spread for the driver
Sandbox_VehicleBallistics2D_OpenableWind: Make side windows of modded vehicles openable
Door windows that cannot be rolled down get the normal Open window / Close window option. Vehicles without an opening animation still look closed, but shots pass.
Sandbox_VehicleBallistics2D_Penetration_: Rounds can go through walls, doors, furniture, trees and vehicles if their energy is high enough. They fly on slower (less damage) and slightly deflected. Needs Viewpoint True Ballistics.
Sandbox_VehicleBallistics2D_PenetrationZ: Penetration: zombies behind walls can be hit
Sandbox_VehicleBallistics2D_PenetrationP: Penetration: players behind walls can be hit
Off: rounds that went through something pass players behind it.
Sandbox_VehicleBallistics2D_PenetrationS: Multiplies every material value below. Higher = fewer penetrations.
Sandbox_VehicleBallistics2D_EnergyLoss_t: Of the energy left after an obstacle (tumbling, deformation).
Sandbox_VehicleBallistics2D_Ricochets_to: Rounds that do not get through hard material at a flat angle can bounce off and fly on.
Sandbox_VehicleBallistics2D_RicochetAngl: Ricochets: maximum angle to the surface (degrees)
Sandbox_VehicleBallistics2D_J_Glass_tool: Energy a round needs to get through. For comparison: .22 about 150 J, 9 mm 500, .45 550, .357 750, 5.56 1700, 7.62x39 2000, .308 3400, 12 gauge slug 3000, buckshot pellet 180.
